summary: Storage is currently instance-local (tied to ~/.local/share/opencode/storage/), violating the requirement that impulse and activity storage be invariant across different instances when using the same metabob_api_key and project_id.

components.currentBehavior: Writes to local filesystem at ~/.local/share/opencode/storage/ with no backend integration
components.desiredBehavior: Should use hybrid storage (backend + local fallback) to ensure instance-agnostic access
components.gap: No backend storage client, no hybrid storage pattern, hardcoded to local filesystem

components.currentBehavior: Resolves to instance-local path based on XDG_DATA_HOME or homedir() which varies by user/machine/container
components.desiredBehavior: Should be used only for local backup/fallback, not primary storage
components.gap: Path varies by environment (root cause of instance locality)

components.currentBehavior: Uses read-modify-write pattern without version checking, causing lost update problem in concurrent writes
components.desiredBehavior: Should use optimistic locking with version field to detect conflicts and retry
components.gap: No version field, no conflict detection, no retry logic

components.currentBehavior: Skips persistence for standalone sessions, causing impulse loss on process exit
components.desiredBehavior: Should persist standalone session impulses to separate storage key for cross-instance access
components.gap: No persistence mechanism for standalone session impulses

components.currentBehavior: Uses process-local lock that doesn't coordinate across instances
components.desiredBehavior: Should use distributed lock (Redis/Database) to coordinate across instances

dataFlow: LLM tool call → ImpulseCreateTool.execute → SessionMemory.addImpulse → Storage.write(session-memory) → local filesystem (~/.local/share/opencode/storage/) | syncImpulseToActivity → Activity.addImpulses → Storage.write(activity) → local filesystem
desiredDataFlow: LLM tool call → ImpulseCreateTool.execute → SessionMemory.addImpulse → HybridStorage.write → (1) try backend API → (2) always local backup | syncImpulseToActivity → Activity.addImpulses with optimistic lock → HybridStorage.write with version check → backend PATCH with CRDT merge + local backup
rootCauses: Process-local locking doesn't coordinate across instances
Read-modify-write race condition causes lost updates

criticalRisks.issue: No validation of key segments - could contain ../
Backend API calls have no Authorization header
criticalRisks.impact: No access control (anyone can read/write activities)
Different projects may overwrite each other

tasks: Add key segment validation in Storage.write() (path traversal fix)
Add Authorization header to backend API calls
Add project_id to storage keys (prevent collision)
Modify Storage.read/write to use hybrid backend
Add circuit breaker for backend calls
Add retry queue for failed writes
Add metrics and monitoring (latency, errors, throughput)

reusablePatterns.purpose: Prevent lost updates in concurrent writes

reusablePatterns.applicability: Any feature needing fast reads + reliable persistence

reusablePatterns.purpose: Fail fast when backend is known to be unavailable

successCriteria: Instance A (user=avi, machine=laptop, project_id=proj_123) creates impulse 'trace-x'
Instance B (user=root, machine=docker, project_id=proj_123) can load impulse 'trace-x'
Backend unavailable → Instances fall back to local storage (graceful degradation)
No silent data loss in concurrent writes
